newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo weak as Kleinwort rates "weak hold".
newsitem.headline: Glaxo weak as Kleinwort rates "weak hold".

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc weakened in a rising UK equity market on Wednesday amid cautious comment on the stock from Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, dealers said.

Analyst Peter McDougal, recently recruited to Kleinwort from BZW, was said to have rated the drug group a "weak hold" because of its long-term growth prospects, though McDougal was not immediately available for comment.
Glaxo shares were down 1-1/2p at 12.03-1/2 stg, even as the FTSE 100 index gained 26.1 points to 4,583.9. In New York on Tuesday, Glaxo ADRs fell $5/8 to $39-1/8.
Glaxo's U.S. patent on its blockbuster Zantac ulcer treatment expires in July.
